pages.title: Enough Is Enough
pages.text: Turn stored count into a control signal; hoppers and electron tubes help attach the next supply line.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Select item, threshold and above/below mode; insert or remove actual stock. This reports network contents rather than generating items.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Set a Level Emitter to compare stored count against a threshold, choosing above or below. Emit redstone based on network contents.
